scenario: AITA For refusing to sit next to a kid with autism during a lecture, and sitting on the floor instead? | I know this sounds bad but bare with me, I’m (23m) in a class that has exactly 30 seats, and there are 31 students. I was running late and walked in a minute before the lecture began. There was only one open seat. I walked over to it and in the next seat over sitting was a kid with autism, he is very socially inept but totally brilliant. The problem is that he smelled like he hadn’t showered in a few weeks, his hair was greasier than Snapes, and he was wearing stained pajamas. I sat next to him for 2 minutes before I was about to gag and I got up and sat on the floor in the back of the lecture hall. After class a few of the kids said I was TA because I should have just sucked it up for the hour and dealt with the smell. So Reddit AITA?
